reason: We have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years, and I am not ready to disrupt our routine or risk assistants accidentally moving or deleting folders in Google Drive. For a mid-sized team like ours, switching everyone to new software without seeing it seamlessly integrated into our daily workflow isn't worth the friction.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Foolproof delete and move protection on Google Drive folders so assistants cannot tamper with them, along with native WhatsApp integration so we don't have to change our ten-year routine.
